metaTitle: Private Event Ads Case Study: 72:1 ROAS | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Google Ads filled private events for The Boathouse (72:1 ROAS, $30.58 per lead) and The Odyssey (49:1 ROAS, 951 conversions), plus Castaway, in 2025.
ldHeadline: Private event Google Ads for The Boathouse, The Odyssey and Castaway
h1Sub: The Boathouse, The Odyssey and Castaway
answer: We ran Google Ads for private events and reservations at three restaurants in 2025. At The Boathouse, every $1 of ads brought back about $72 in tracked value.

metrics.label: ROAS, The Boathouse
metrics.meaning: Every $1 of ads brought back about $72 in tracked private-event value, May to Dec 2025.

metrics.label: Per private-event lead, The Boathouse
metrics.meaning: What each event inquiry cost. A single booked event can bring in thousands.

metrics.label: ROAS, The Odyssey
metrics.meaning: Dinner reservations plus private events: about $49 back for every $1, Jun to Dec 2025.

paragraphs: A private event is a big-ticket booking: each one that converts can bring in thousands.
The goal is to reach people who are already planning an event and turn their search into an inquiry, not to buy as many clicks as possible.

items.title: Show up when planners search by name
items.bodyHtml: Branded search ads for The Boathouse's private events. Branded search means your ad shows when someone searches for the restaurant by name, so your own ad is the first thing a planner sees.

items.title: Split events from dinner
items.bodyHtml: Separate campaigns for dinner reservations and for private events at The Odyssey and at Castaway, so each goal has its own budget and its own numbers.

items.title: Track every inquiry and booking
items.bodyHtml: So each campaign is judged on what it brings back, not on clicks.

items.title: Report against spend every month
items.bodyHtml: Conversions, cost per conversion, conversion value and ROAS, every month, in plain numbers.

results.explainHtml: How to read these numbers: a conversion is one tracked action, like a private-event inquiry, a reservation or a call. ROAS (return on ad spend) compares the tracked value of those conversions with what the ads cost.
